messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend** periods created by Canada’s federal holidays in 2023 (dates shown in *YYYY‑MM‑DD* format):

| Long‑Weekend | Holiday(s) | Start | End |
|--------------|------------|-------|-----|
| New Year’s Weekend | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 02) | 2023‑01‑01 | 2023‑01‑02 |
| Family Day Weekend | Family Day (Mon Feb 20) | 2023‑02‑18 | 2023‑02‑20 |
| Good Friday Weekend | Good Friday (Fri Apr 07) | 2023‑04‑07 | 2023‑04‑08 |
| Victoria Day Weekend | Victoria Day (Mon May 22) | 2023‑05‑20 | 2023‑05‑22 |
| Canada Day Weekend | Canada Day (Sat Jul 01 – observed Mon Jul 03) | 2023‑06‑30 | 2023‑07‑03 |
| Labour Day Weekend | Labour Day (Mon Sep 04) | 2023‑09‑02 | 2023‑09‑04 |
| Thanksgiving Weekend | Thanksgiving (Mon Oct 09) | 2023‑10‑07 | 2023‑10‑09 |
| Christmas Weekend | Christmas (Mon Dec 25) | 2023‑12‑23 | 2023‑12‑25 |

> **Note:**  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekend, the “observed” day is usually the following Monday, creating a long weekend.  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Family Day in Alberta, etc.) that may add extra long weekends—check your specific province for those details.
